CP1.reason: Evidence states the establishment is registered to conduct export operations for wheat and all export activities are within the registered scope as approved by DAFF.

CP2.reason: No evidence explicitly confirms that the registration is not suspended at the time of export operations. The evidence only mentions registration scope, not suspension status.

CP3.reason: The site plan document is referenced but no actual content is provided showing the area of the premises that is registered for export operations.

CP4.reason: The site plan document is referenced but no actual content is provided showing important features of the registered area and adjoining sites.

CP5.reason: The site plan document is referenced but no actual content is provided showing the layout of areas where export operations occur.

CP6.reason: The CP is conditional on 'where required' changes occurring. Evidence explicitly states no changes have occurred, so the notification requirement is not triggered.
CP6.na_gate_reason: The CP is conditional on 'where required' changes occurring. Evidence explicitly states no changes have occurred, so the notification requirement is not triggered.

Should any such changes occur, DAFF will be notified in writing within the required timeframe as per Rule 4-6 of the Export Control (Plants and Plant Products) Rules 2021.

CP7.na_gate_reason: The CP is conditional on alterations occurring. Evidence explicitly states no structural alterations or additions have been carried out, so the approval requirement is not triggered.
